rationale: Post-mutation work is 96%+ semantic review (value/range re-reads in wider context) and LO recalc observation feeding judgment. Pure mechanical persistence checking is 12/405 calls (3.0%), all file-existence shells. No model-visible mechanism clears the materiality bar.
falsification_of_receipt_branch: agents almost never query 'did it save / did N cells change'; they query resulting values in context (20/24 readback episodes include wider context) and recalc outcomes. A pushed receipt answers questions not asked.
reopen_conditions: a LO-capable environment where error-count/downstream-change attestation demonstrably replaces measured queries; not this sandbox
recommended_next: none in verification; deterministic-optimization program has closed mutation-authoring and verification branches
